description: Privileged Zoho Mail API client: OAuth consent via localhost callback, token storage in Thunderbird's password manager, and spam-report calls. (Not affiliated with Zoho.)

functions.name: connect
functions.description: Start OAuth consent for a Zoho data center ('.com', '.eu', '.in', '.com.au', '.com.cn'). Opens browser; listens on localhost for the redirect; stores refresh token. Resolves with the connections list.

functions.name: disconnect
functions.description: Remove a stored connection and its tokens.

functions.name: connections
functions.description: List connections with their mailboxes (email, accountId, dc).

functions.name: reportSpam
functions.description: PUT updatemessage mode=moveToSpam for one messageId on an accountId.
